pk.context: 10 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: An atypical antipsychotic with a long, variable half-life (21 to 54 hours) and no contraindications with monotherapy.

clues.text: Well absorbed, and food does not affect absorption. It is 93% bound to plasma proteins and cleared mainly by direct glucuronidation and cytochrome P450 oxidation.
Molecular weight 312.44. It is a crystalline solid that is practically insoluble in water.
An NDA product in 2.5 to 20 mg tablets, with doses adjusted in 5 mg steps once daily.
Boxed warning for increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis. No contraindications with monotherapy; postural hypotension and weight gain are common.
Treatment of schizophrenia in adults and adolescents, and agitation with schizophrenia or bipolar I mania when given by injection.
Its action is unclear, but efficacy may come from combined dopamine and serotonin type 2 antagonism.
The generic name begins with O and has ten letters.
